modules.title: Global Leadership Essentials
modules.description: Foundational leadership skills applicable across all cultures and geographies, covering situational leadership, emotional intelligence, and coaching.
learningObjectives: Apply the four Situational Leadership styles
Develop emotional intelligence across its five domains
Coach team members using the GROW model
Give effective, behaviour-focused feedback
modules.audience: All managers and aspiring leaders globally

modules.title: Ethics & Code of Conduct
modules.description: Universal Code of Conduct training defining ethical behavior, conflict of interest management, and speaking-up culture applicable across all global operations.
learningObjectives: Apply the organization's Code of Conduct in real-world scenarios
Identify and disclose conflicts of interest
Use reporting channels to raise ethical concerns
Model ethical leadership behavior

modules.title: Unconscious Bias — Global Edition
modules.description: Global unconscious bias awareness training with culturally localized examples, helping employees recognize and reduce bias in everyday decisions.
learningObjectives: Identify major categories of unconscious bias
Recognize personal bias patterns through self-reflection
Apply bias-mitigation strategies in hiring and promotion
Foster more equitable team interactions

modules.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals — Global
modules.description: Essential cybersecurity awareness for all employees covering phishing, password security, safe browsing, and device management — mandatory globally.
learningObjectives: Recognize phishing, smishing, and vishing attempts
Apply strong authentication practices
Safely use company devices and networks
Report security incidents through the correct channels

modules.title: Global Anti-Bribery & Corruption
modules.description: Core anti-bribery and corruption training aligned with FCPA, UK Bribery Act, and global best practices, applicable to all employees worldwide.
learningObjectives: Understand FCPA and UK Bribery Act global reach
Apply appropriate gifts and hospitality policies
Conduct adequate third-party due diligence
Report bribery and corruption concerns promptly

modules.title: Cultural Intelligence (CQ) — Introduction
modules.description: Introduction to Cultural Intelligence (CQ) using Hofstede, Meyer, and Trompenaars frameworks to build cross-cultural awareness and adaptation skills.
learningObjectives: Understand key cultural dimension frameworks
Assess your own cultural background and its business impact
Identify cultural differences in communication and decision-making styles
Adapt your approach to diverse cultural contexts

modules.title: Data Privacy Fundamentals — Global
modules.description: Global data privacy fundamentals covering core principles applicable across GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, LGPD, and other major privacy regimes.
learningObjectives: Apply universal data privacy principles across regulatory contexts
Handle personal data with appropriate care and purpose limitation
Recognize privacy risks and escalate appropriately
Respect individual rights over their personal data

modules.title: Mental Health Awareness — Global
modules.description: Global mental health awareness training helping all employees recognize stress, anxiety, and burnout, and access support resources worldwide.
learningObjectives: Recognize common mental health conditions and their workplace signals
Understand the impact of mental health on performance and wellbeing
Access Employee Assistance Programs and global support resources
Support colleagues experiencing mental health challenges

modules.title: Global Communication & Collaboration
modules.description: Effective communication and collaboration skills for global teams, covering virtual meeting management, asynchronous communication, and cross-cultural collaboration.
learningObjectives: Facilitate effective virtual meetings across time zones
Write clear, culturally inclusive global communications
Manage asynchronous collaboration tools effectively
Navigate cross-cultural communication challenges

modules.title: Sustainability & ESG — Global Foundations
modules.description: Universal ESG and sustainability foundations helping all employees understand the organization's sustainability commitments and their role in achieving them.
learningObjectives: Understand the business case for sustainability and ESG
Apply the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals to business operations
Contribute to the organization's net-zero targets
Make sustainable decisions in daily work

modules.title: Modern Slavery Awareness — Global
modules.description: Global modern slavery awareness for all employees, covering indicators of exploitation, supply chain risks, and reporting mechanisms.
learningObjectives: Recognize modern slavery, forced labor, and human trafficking indicators
Understand supply chain modern slavery risks in your sector
Report modern slavery concerns through the correct channels
Apply the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights

modules.title: AI Literacy for Business Professionals
modules.description: Practical AI literacy for business professionals — understanding AI capabilities, responsible use of generative AI tools, and AI-augmented work practices.
learningObjectives: Understand AI, machine learning, and generative AI fundamentals
Use AI tools productively and responsibly in your role
Identify appropriate and inappropriate use cases for AI
Apply critical thinking to AI-generated outputs

modules.title: Inclusive Communication — Global
modules.description: Building inclusive communication habits — respectful language, active listening, amplification, and navigating difficult conversations across all global contexts.
learningObjectives: Use inclusive, respectful language in all communications
Practice active listening that validates all voices
Amplify marginalized perspectives in group settings
Navigate microaggressions and correct them constructively

modules.title: Financial Acumen for Non-Finance Managers
modules.description: Building financial literacy for managers who don't have a finance background — P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, budgeting, and business case development.
learningObjectives: Read and interpret P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
Build and manage departmental budgets
Develop compelling business cases with financial justification
Apply ROI and payback analysis
modules.audience: Non-finance managers and team leads globally

modules.title: Instructional Design Practitioner
modules.description: Professional development for L&D practitioners — covering ADDIE, SAM, Bloom's taxonomy, learning needs analysis, and global content localization.
learningObjectives: Apply ADDIE and SAM instructional design models
Conduct global learning needs analyses
Design for diverse learning styles and cultural contexts
Develop, pilot, and evaluate L&D programs for global audiences
